description: This file defines an interface named AuthSchemeResolverInterface within the Aws\Auth namespace. It declares a method for selecting an authentication scheme for request signing, intended to be implemented by classes that resolve which auth scheme to use based on provided authentication schemes and identity credentials.

classes.name: AuthSchemeResolverInterface
classes.description: An interface that determines which authentication scheme will be used for request signing, requiring implementation of the selectAuthScheme method.

methods.name: selectAuthScheme
methods.description: Selects an authentication scheme for request signing based on a priority-ordered list of schemes and identity credentials.
